summary: Garena Free Fire entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Garena Free Fire
entries.definitive_edition: Current Free Fire MAX mobile client where supported

emulation.notes: Free Fire is officially mobile-only; prefer Android/iOS hardware capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Free Fire MAX on supported mobile hardware at current patch level

primary.version: Current Free Fire MAX where supported
primary.why: Free Fire is a mobile-only online battle royale on Android and iOS. Garena presents Free Fire MAX as the premium visual route with Ultra HD-style presentation and Firelink compatibility with Free Fire players, so MAX is the fidelity route when supported.
primary.how_to_play: Use Free Fire MAX on supported Android/iOS hardware for capture, or standard Free Fire if device support requires it. Record app version/OB patch, region, account, ranked season, mode, character/pet loadout, event/collaboration state, and whether MAX or standard client was used.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service patches, events, collaborations, and regional availability change. Record OB patch and account/region state.
